pushPolicy: One commit per finding; push all three commits only after the final commit.

findings.implementation: Shared sample normalization uses the shaper’s locale-aware per-grapheme case/style rules, including span overrides and provider-local styles. Partial transitions remain ambiguous even when normalized endpoint strings agree; correction artwork uses base styles without source spans. Legacy system text is unchanged.

Shared label/caption panel layouts feed both emitted rectangles and footprint checks. Checks include panel protection, clipping and cross-overlay collisions; a panel does not collide with its own text/qualification. Default E01 captions use a narrower inset text/background region, and OUTSIDE moves 20 pixels inward; supplied copy, timing and physical plate inputs are preserved.

verification.portraitBrowser: passed; both 61-frame original/corrected anchor controls preserve reverse seeks and transformed endpoints

retainedE01.measurement: Fresh pinned-font text measurement against retained real sidecars; no new 3D capture or final encode.

findings.implementation: Anchor occlusion selects each intersection’s effective face-group material, respects object/material visibility, and applies the shader’s strict float32 opacity/cutoff comparison. Current supported procedural maps are opaque; capture source identities invalidate older cache entries automatically.

verification.shaderBoundary: 0.49 discards; 0.5 and float32-rounded 0.499999999 retain opaque occlusion.

retainedFailures: Initial sandboxed worktree dependency installation was denied; the authorized rerun reused all locked dependencies.

First case implementation run found a duplicate local variable and exact-optional-property type issue; corrected before the 50-test and type-check pass.
Panel baseline: all four new regressions fail before the fix; all 13 overlay tests pass after it.

Checking the retained E01 with panel footprints exposed caption coverage at frames 346..397 and 6.4 pixels of OUTSIDE panel clipping. Default layouts were repaired within the same panel finding; fresh pinned-font measurement passes all 696 retained sidecar frames.
The first standalone E01 recheck selected aliases from the primary checkout; rerunning from the fix worktree corrected the review-helper import context.

Initial runtime tier passed all 151 runtime tests, then 36 tests in four soundtrack-dependent integration suites failed for the missing worktree audio runtime. All 53 tests in those suites, 14 Python tests and browser smoke pass in the corrected continuation; the initial aggregate remains failed.

All three cutout regressions fail before the raycast filter; all 11 capture tests pass afterward. Initial aggregate runtime remains failed; corrected continuation and refreshed relevant groups complete the verification tier in stages.
